text:
The evidence can't tell us what caused the loss. It only shows that it happened and where.

Hansen/UMD satellite data mapped about 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, roughly 3.4% of the 17.6 ha property. Of that, about 0.5 ha was in mapped native forest and 0.1 ha was outside mapped forest. No planted forest was affected. The JRC 2020 map agrees the area was forest in 2020, and later years were observed, so the loss is corroborated. A further 0.2 ha of smaller patches was not counted as an event.

The data does not establish:
- whether deforestation or a land-use change occurred (it records any stand replacement)
- the cause, such as harvest, fire, storm or clearing
- whether it was legal or authorized
- who was responsible
- any compliance finding

To identify the cause, you would need other evidence, such as higher-resolution imagery, fire records, or site or permit information.
